skill_cards.if_condition: When initial reconnaissance yields no success signal after 3 actions
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger a systematic port scan using nmap with service/version detection

skill_cards.then_action: Pause to re-evaluate goals and prioritize a single high-value vector (RDP/SMB/SSH)

skill_cards.if_condition: When reward is positive but success flag is false
skill_cards.then_action: Pivot to credential discovery and verify access paths before exploitation

memory_ops.reason: Baseline recon via targeted nmap scanning is a reliable first step when progress stalls.
